neighbours.label: The word piece ' mon' / ' Mon' that opens a word the tokenizer splits (mon|ies, mon|soon, mon|oxide, mon|ogram, mon|ologue, Mon|mouth); mon-words that are their own token (money, Monday, month, monitor, monarch, monument, Monaco) do not carry it
fire: The treasurer must account for all monies received from the fair.
Farmers wait anxiously for the monsoon to break in June.
The lecturer's monotonous delivery emptied the hall by noon.
A faulty boiler can release carbon monoxide into the house.
Each towel was embroidered with a small monogram in blue thread.
Her monograph on Roman glass took eleven years to complete.
The actor delivered the final monologue without a single pause.
The town of Monmouth sits where two rivers meet.
quiet: The treasurer must account for all money received from the fair.
Farmers wait anxiously for Monday's market to open in June.
The lecturer's dull delivery emptied the hall by noon.
A faulty boiler can leave the house without heat for a month.
Each towel was embroidered with a small monkey in blue thread.
Her study of Roman glass took eleven years and a monumental effort.
The actor delivered the final lines without a single pause.
The town of Monaco sits where the mountains meet the sea.
